verdict.rationale: Publishing guidance on non-US startup instruments is a fair question for a startup law firm, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no publications or advice on UK EMI, German VSOP, Indian FDI/ESOP or French BSPCE rules. Its equity-compensation material is US-centric (IRC 280G/409A), and its GDPR and Madrid Protocol mentions cover privacy and trademarks, not startup equity instruments.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes on jurisdiction-specific startup instruments and rules of my market — e.g. UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE
